description: This file contains Pydantic model definitions used for request/response validation in a career path planning backend. It defines data schemas for roles, competencies, user profiles, career plans, goals, gap analysis, and related entities, aligned with database schemas and views.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a job role from the catalog.

classes.name: RoleCompetency
classes.description: Mapping row indicating competency requirements for a role.

classes.name: RoleAdjacency
classes.description: Edge in a role adjacency graph, weighted by similarity/transition ease.

classes.name: RoleCard
classes.description: Rich content for a role card (markdown or structured content).

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Current user's basic profile returned by /me endpoint.

classes.name: Plan
classes.description: Represents a career plan owned by a user.

classes.name: Goal
classes.description: Represents a goal within a plan.

classes.name: GoalCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a goal within a plan.

classes.name: GapItem
classes.description: Single competency gap analysis item for a target role.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResponse
classes.description: Response payload for gap analysis against a target role.

classes.name: RoleIn
classes.description: Payload to create a new role.

classes.name: RoleListResponse
classes.description: Wrapper for listing roles (reserved for future pagination/metadata).
